319	    const resolvedAgent = allAgents.find(a => a.filename === agentToUse || a.name === agentToUse)
320	    setRunning(true)
321	    setOutput('')
322	    outputAccRef.current = ''
323	    flushPendingRef.current = false
324	    hasWarnedLongOutputRef.current = false
325	    setActivityLog([])
326	    setElapsedMs(0)
327	    setActiveHistoryId(null)
328	    setShowRating(false)
329	    startTimeRef.current = Date.now()
330	    abortRef.current = new AbortController()
331	
332	    // Client-side idle watchdog. Server sends heartbeat comments every ~15s so the
333	    // 90s idle timer only fires if the stream is truly dead (server crash, network
334	    // drop, proxy buffering). The read loop below calls resetIdleTimer() each time
335	    // reader.read() returns bytes, including heartbeats.
336	    const CLIENT_IDLE_MS = 90_000
337	    const resetIdleTimer = () => {
338	      if (idleTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(idleTimerRef.current)
339	      idleTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
340	        try {
341	          abortRef.current?.abort(new DOMException('Stream idle timeout', 'TimeoutError'))
342	        } catch {
343	          abortRef.current?.abort()
344	        }
345	      }, CLIENT_IDLE_MS)
346	    }
347	    resetIdleTimer()
348	
349	    try {
350	      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
351	        agentName: agentToUse || undefined,
352	        prompt: testPrompt,
353	        timeoutMs: settings.timeoutMs,
354	      }
355	      if (settings.customInstructions.trim()) {
356	        body.customInstructions = settings.customInstructions.trim()
357	      }
358	
359	      const response = await fetch('/api/playground/run', {
360	        method: 'POST',
361	        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
362	        body: JSON.stringify(body),
363	        signal: abortRef.current.signal,
364	      })
365	
366	      if (!response.ok) {
367	        const errText = await response.text().catch(() => `HTTP ${response.status}`)
368	        const isClient = response.status >= 400 && response.status < 500
369	        throw new Error(isClient
370	          ? `Bad request (${response.status}): ${errText.slice(0, 200)}`
371	          : `Server error (${response.status}). Try again.`)
372	      }
373	      if (!response.body) throw new Error('No response body')
374	      const reader = response.body.getReader()
375	      const decoder = new TextDecoder()
376	      let buffer = ''
377	      let fullOutput = ''
378	      let hadError = false
379	
380	      // rAF-based flush: batches rapid SSE chunks into single React state updates
381	      const flushOutput = () => { setOutput(outputAccRef.current); flushPendingRef.current = false }
382	
383	      const processLine = (line: string) => {
384	        const trimmed = line.trim()
385	        // Ignore SSE heartbeat comments (start with ':') — they're present only to
386	        // keep the connection alive. Bytes consumed already reset the idle timer.
387	        if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) return
388	        try {
389	          const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
390	          if (event.type === 'start') {
391	            resetIdleTimer()
392	          } else if (event.type === 'chunk') {
393	            fullOutput += event.content
394	            outputAccRef.current = fullOutput
395	            if (!flushPendingRef.current) {
396	              flushPendingRef.current = true
397	              rafIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(flushOutput)
398	            }
399	            // Warn once when output gets very large
400	            if (fullOutput.length > 400_000 && !hasWarnedLongOutputRef.current) {
401	              hasWarnedLongOutputRef.current = true
402	              toast('error', 'Output is very large (>400KB) and may not be fully saved between sessions.')
403	            }
404	          } else if (event.type === 'activity') {
405	            const elapsed = Date.now() - startTimeRef.current
406	            setActivityLog(prev => [...prev.slice(-49), { message: event.message, time: elapsed }])
407	          } else if (event.type === 'warning') {
408	            const elapsed = Date.now() - startTimeRef.current
409	            const scope = event.scope ? `[${event.scope}] ` : ''
410	            setActivityLog(prev => [...prev.slice(-49), { message: `Warning: ${scope}${event.message}`, time: elapsed }])
411	          } else if (event.type === 'stalled') {
412	            const elapsed = Date.now() - startTimeRef.current
413	            const secs = Math.round((event.idleMs || 0) / 1000)
414	            setActivityLog(prev => [...prev.slice(-49), { message: `Stream stalled: no output for ${secs}s (server will terminate soon)`, time: elapsed }])
415	          } else if (event.type === 'done') {
416	            fullOutput = event.output || fullOutput
417	            setOutput(fullOutput)
418	          } else if (event.type === 'error') {
419	            fullOutput = fullOutput ? `${fullOutput}\n\n---\nError: ${event.error}` : `Error: ${event.error}`
420	            setOutput(fullOutput)
421	            hadError = true
422	          }
423	        } catch (err) {
424	          console.warn('[playground] malformed SSE event', trimmed.slice(0, 200), err)
425	          const elapsed = Date.now() - startTimeRef.current
426	          setActivityLog(prev => [...prev.slice(-49), { message: 'Warning: dropped malformed server event', time: elapsed }])
427	        }
428	      }
429	
430	      while (true) {
431	        const { done, value } = await reader.read()
432	        if (done) break
433	        resetIdleTimer()
434	        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
435	        // Guard against non-delimited giant chunks (memory protection)
436	        if (buffer.length > 1_000_000) {
437	          abortRef.current?.abort()
438	          toast('error', 'Server sent an unexpectedly large response — stream aborted.')
439	          break
440	        }
441	        const parts = buffer.split('\n')
442	        buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
443	        for (const line of parts) processLine(line)
444	      }
445	
446	      // Flush remaining buffer
447	      if (buffer.trim()) {
448	        for (const line of buffer.split('\n')) processLine(line)
449	      }
450	
451	      const duration = Date.now() - startTimeRef.current
452	      const agentDisplay = resolvedAgent?.name || agentToUse || 'No Agent'
453	      // Ensure final output state is synced (flush any pending rAF)
454	      setOutput(outputAccRef.current)
455	      const newItem: TestResult = {
456	        id: genId(),
457	        agent: agentToUse || '',
458	        agentName: agentDisplay,
459	        prompt: testPrompt,
460	        output: fullOutput,
461	        duration,
462	        status: hadError ? 'error' : 'success',
463	        timestamp: new Date(),
464	      }
465	      persistResult(newItem)
466	
467	    } catch (err: unknown) {
468	      const duration = Date.now() - startTimeRef.current
469	      const abortReason = abortRef.current?.signal.reason as { name?: string } | undefined
470	      const isIdleTimeout = err instanceof Error && err.name === 'AbortError'
471	        && (abortReason?.name === 'TimeoutError' || (err as Error & { cause?: { name?: string } }).cause?.name === 'TimeoutError')
472	
473	      const agentDisplay = resolvedAgent?.name || agentToUse || 'No Agent'
474	      if (isIdleTimeout) {
475	        const msg = `No response from server for ${Math.round(CLIENT_IDLE_MS / 1000)}s — stream aborted. The agent may have crashed or the server is unreachable.`
476	        setOutput(prev => prev ? `${prev}\n\n---\nError: ${msg}` : `Error: ${msg}`)
477	        persistResult({
478	          id: genId(),
479	          agent: agentToUse || '',
480	          agentName: agentDisplay,
481	          prompt: testPrompt,
482	          output: `Error: ${msg}`,
483	          duration,
484	          status: 'error',
485	          timestamp: new Date(),
486	        })
487	      } else if (err instanceof Error && err.name === 'AbortError') {
488	        setOutput(prev => prev ? prev + '\n\n---\n*Test cancelled by user*' : 'Test cancelled.')
489	      } else {
490	        const errMsg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
491	        setOutput(`Error: ${errMsg}`)
492	        persistResult({
